ucas.constraint: Map every adopted feature and acceptance obligation.

ucas.context: Plan or model response is misreported as runtime acceptance.
ucas.constraint: Require candidate-bound runtime and independent evidence.

ucas.context: Expired task or stale evidence is reused for effects.
ucas.constraint: Reconcile current claims and effect-time fences.

ucas.context: Observer outlives finite authority or stale success remains green.
ucas.constraint: Bound job lifetime, preserve expiry and renew only reviewed grants.

decision.summary: Finite unchanged observer renewal while Telegram command work continues; no source/backend expansion.
alternatives: Reuse existing execution task IDs with a coverage map: selected.
Duplicate all feature tasks or mark unsupported behavior complete: rejected.
counterevidence: Historical inventory reports54missingadapters; current functionality requires fresh review.
Earlier risk copied release-hazard severity onto a read-only visibility task; corrected scope-specific severity after direct observer-fence and UI expiry review.
assumptions: Existing adopted contracts preserve full feature scope.
decision.forecast: Expect exact coverage map to expose remaining critical path; no guaranteed completion date.
decision.falsifier: Any adopted feature or current incomplete execution task has no mapped owner and acceptance.
acceptance: Exact unchanged source/control/HTML binding
Independent AGY config review
Old unit stopped before replacement
Fresh snapshot with finite expiry and 300s/task-completion refresh
decision.rollback: Preserve original plans and history; no production effects from planning.
decision.reviewer: Actual independent AGY review of exact artifact
decision.budget: One compact bounded job per review; no broad scans or new packages.
residuals: Live Telegram recipient/profile and actual acceptance pending
Global admission and main integration pending
Observer renewal requires separate exact configuration review

scope: Renew unchanged finite dashboard observer with independently reviewed exact config

snapshot.reference: Fresh readonly canonical tasks plus adopted source contracts. Historical classifications are hypotheses until current sources/runtime verified.

fmea_modes.cause: Finite observer grant expires before reviewed renewal.
fmea_modes.effect: Dashboard explicitly becomes stale or expired; no control effect or release admission.
